ability.name: Great Gutlord
ability.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to this unit’s control score and to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit’s attacks.

ability.name: Touched by the Everwinter
ability.effect: If this unit is not a **^^Priest^^**, it has **^^Priest (1)^^**. If this unit is already a **^^Priest^^**, you can re-roll chanting rolls of 1 for it instead. If this unit is a **^^Wizard^^**, it cannot use **^^Spell^^** abilities and **^^Prayer^^** abilities in the same phase.

ability.name: Booming Roar
ability.effect: Subtract 5 from the control scores of enemy **^^Infantry^^** units while they are in combat with this unit.
